name: UGC unboxing · first look
description: Hands open a package and lift the product into frame for a first look, filmed like a real phone video on a table. Use it for launch teasers and first-impression clips.
prompt: Hands lift the product from an opened box on a {{ surface }} table and turn it once toward the camera for a first look. Filmed on a phone from just above the table, daylight from a window, small natural hand movement, the label stays readable and unchanged. {{#if extra}}{{ extra }}.{{/if}} No text on screen, no logos other than the product's own.
negative_prompt: on-screen text, watermark, extra hands, warped label, floating product

slots.name: extra
slots.label: Extra direction
slots.help: e.g. 'a mug of coffee beside the box'
